basic_profile.bio: Enthusiastic mountain biker and tech geek from Boulder, Colorado. I've been shredding trails since my teenage years and have been a part of the Reddit community for over seven years, sharing my love for all things MTB. When I'm not hitting the trails, I work as a software engineer for a tech startup. I'm an early bird, often online in the mornings before work and late evenings. Happily married with two kids and a Boston Terrier named Rex. I enjoy discussing new technologies, sports, and the latest rock albums.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: A seasoned mountain biker with extensive experience gained from years of riding in diverse terrains. I also have a deep understanding of bike mechanics and the latest trends in biking technology, which I keep updated through online forums and community events. My professional background in software engineering gives me a solid grasp of tech-related discussions as well.
